name: Email to alert
description: Turn every email received in a configured mailbox into a pending alert (source email, message-id as external id). The raw .eml and attachments are kept as evidence once the alert is promoted to a case.
setup:
Configure a mailbox under Settings -> Integrations (Mailboxes) first; each new message in its folder fires this workflow.

## Narrowing
Edit the trigger filter, for example `'soc+phishing' in email.to_joined` or `email.has_attachments`.
